notes: 100 newly authored synthetic cases created to differ in wording and scenario from the prior 100-case manual QA dataset.
This is a fresh evaluation set, not proof that the cases are unseen by any training corpus.
Approval labels are illustrative. Replace or confirm them against the actual business policy before using them as ground truth.
Cases with expected value null have expected abstain true; these are intended for abstention behavior testing.
Do not train or tune on this set if you intend to use it as a held-out evaluation set.
